metaTitle: Custom Etched Journals & Notebooks | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom etched journals & notebooks with your logo. Perfect for corporate gifts and events. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Etched journals and notebooks offer a permanent, high-end look that screen printing or foil stamping can't match. The design is carved directly into the cover material, creating a tactile, elegant impression that lasts as long as the notebook itself. This decoration method works especially well on leather, faux leather, and hardcover options, making it a favorite for executive gifts, client appreciation, and milestone events. Choose from lined, dotted, or blank pages to suit your recipients' needs.
heroAltText: Custom etched journals and notebooks with company logo on leather cover, perfect for corporate gifts.
